test: F3-E protected renewal never perpetuates an initial-only promotion without an explicit price policy
setup: Real paid first-period invoice: 324 USD minor units after 10 percent FIRST promotion; explicit price_protected=true and price_notice_required=false
first_result: FAIL: Expected exception: Hostider\Core\Http\HttpError; 13 tests, 1 failure
source_cause: Protected renewal copied net/tax/total from the historical discounted service price while stripping the promotion description
correction: Reject historical promotions/nonzero discount under protected pricing until explicit recurring commercial policy is resolved
verified_after_correction: 13 tests, 0 failures; rejected request creates no renewal or additional journal; explicit unprotected renewal calculates 360 minor units
